title: CAN I EARN RECURRING INCOME SELLING SOMEONE ELSE'S SUBSCRIPTION?
content:
Possibly, but the fact that the customer pays a company every month does not mean the person who referred that customer gets paid every month.

This is the subscription version of the repeat-purchase distinction from the consumables branch. Customer billing and seller compensation are separate mechanisms.

THREE POSSIBILITIES
A program may pay once for the initial subscription sale. It may pay recurring commission while the customer remains subscribed and the referral remains eligible. Or it may use another structure entirely.

You cannot infer the compensation model from the product's billing model.

WHAT TO VERIFY
Before treating a subscription affiliate program as recurring income, verify the current commission terms, how long recurring commission lasts, what happens after cancellation and reactivation, attribution rules, refunds or chargebacks, payout requirements, account requirements, and any conditions that can end eligibility.

DEPENDENCE MATTERS
Even a genuinely recurring affiliate program remains controlled by another company. The vendor can affect the product, pricing, customer retention, program rules, and sometimes whether the program continues.

If you are comfortable with that relationship and want to investigate specific recurring affiliate opportunities, continue to PDF 38.

A SIMPLE EXAMPLE

A customer pays $30 each month for software. Program A might pay an affiliate $20 once when the customer signs up. Program B might pay 20 percent of qualifying monthly payments while the customer remains subscribed. Program C might use an entirely different arrangement.

All three customers are buying subscriptions. Only one example necessarily creates recurring affiliate compensation.

THE DECISION

If your goal is recurring seller income, do not stop at finding a recurring customer charge. Verify that the compensation relationship itself recurs under conditions you understand.

WHERE TO GO NEXT
Continue to PDF 38 to explore recurring affiliate programs. If you want to control the subscription offer yourself, return to PDF 31 and choose the ownership route.
